_comment: Personal spawns: each player gets their own chests, collectables and monsters, anchored to real places.

monsters.name: Bog Wraith
monsters.flavour: A cold patch of air that follows the towpath.

monsters.name: Fen Troll
monsters.flavour: Sleeps under the bridge; wakes for footsteps.

monsters.name: Gutter Drake
monsters.flavour: Small, quick, and fond of bins.

monsters.name: Hollow Knight
monsters.flavour: Armour with nobody in it, still patrolling.

monsters.name: Mire Hag
monsters.flavour: Has been waiting by this pond a very long time.

monsters.name: Lamp Sprite
monsters.flavour: Flickers when you look straight at it.

monsters.name: Rook Lord
monsters.flavour: Holds the park by the sheer number of rooks.

monsters.name: Cinder Hound
monsters.flavour: Faster than it looks. Look again.

monsters.name: Moss Golem
monsters.flavour: Mostly wall. The moss is the dangerous part.

monsters.name: Tide Serpent
monsters.flavour: Only ever seen at the water's edge.

monsters.name: Grey Stag
monsters.flavour: Stands in the mist and dares you.

monsters.name: Ash Warden
monsters.flavour: Guards a place that burned down long ago.
